title: Texas-Sized Number
statementMd:
One day, Johnny thought of a non-negative integer n𝑛, but unfortunately, he thinks the number is too small.

To make the number bigger, Johnny decides to make the number a *Texas-Sized Number*. To find the Texas-Sized Number of n𝑛, Johnny must calculate n+10⋅n+100⋅n+1000⋅n+...+101010⋅n.

𝑛+10⋅𝑛+100⋅𝑛+1000⋅𝑛+...+101010⋅𝑛.

However, because this number takes too long to calculate, Johnny is only interested in the most common digit in the Texas-Sized Number of n. Can you help him find this digit?

## Input

The first line contains one non-negative integer n — the number that Johnny thought of. This integer can be up to 105 digits long.

## Output

Output a single integer — the most common digit in the Texas-Sized Number of n. If there is a tie, output any most common digit.
